en_US: Baoba: It is you!

Welcome to the Safari Zone!
It hasn’t been open too long, but you
can enjoy all the fun!
Please feel free to enjoy my safari!
Baoba: I will keep upgrading my safari.
I will let you know using Pokégear if I
make any changes.
Safari Zone...
It makes me feel like I am in a
foreign country.
It brings up a strange feeling.
(I am not a talker.)

so interesting, huh!

blue sky. Sprinkly goes your sweat to
celebrate a friendship.
I love the Safari Zone!
...I made a whole jingle out of it.

I’ve decided to carry Pokémon drinks.

my best...

Just a minute...

but nothing beats the cuteness of
Slowpoke.

Pokémon at the Safari Zone.

there is a sophisticated system to
customizing the Safari Zone, right?

I am so exhausted...

the wild!
